The faceplate and knobs - the panel's look - are this project's; the keys, encoders, thumbstick and ribbon behind it are the electrical build's with the DCU (electrical D-374). No board and no drop: a key matrix and rotary encoders on a local ribbon to the DCU behind it. Keys: defog · hatch · fuel door · HVAC mode · fan · temperature · recirc · seat knobs · the four window commands; plus the mirror thumbstick (LP35), press toggles side (D-359). A/C mode is gone with the compressor (K-015). Frame 0x400, sent by the DCU. Parked operation is a PMU gate, not a connector: every key carries an A16 precondition EXCEPT hatch and fuel-door release, and A16 is a ladder read, never a CAN term
Display only — no automatic climate control; the outside sensor plugs into L2-OAT at the nose (L2-S 5 → DP-DCU 2, electrical D-256 / D-274), cabin sensor local to the DCU

O4 is wired and configured, disabled; the panel key enables it over CAN - a comfort command, fails to off. The trigger is now written: A16 >= ACC && panel_defog, with the A16 floor read from the ladder so a stray press with the car asleep cannot switch 11.5 A of grid
